releases.summary: Teaches agents the canonical schema-6 Team, named-view, and linked-member contracts.

changes.text: Author only schema-6 Team files with workspaces, owned agents, persistent linked agents, and named presentation views.
Keep owned-member lifecycle independent from view placement, isolate unavailable remote members per member, and recover explicitly stopped incomplete create-once attempts without database resets.
Use paired workspace and runtime aliases in portable files while retaining stable ownership and authority inside Termbrio Server.
Discover authorized linked-into teams through one-hop team_info without recursively expanding federation.

releases.summary: Adds owner-controlled remote teams and capability-aware TeamRelay delivery.

changes.text: Added owner-controlled remote SessionHost execution through paired Server brokers.
Added semantic safe, active-turn, queue, and authorized interrupt delivery policies with per-recipient audit outcomes.
Show placed team members with their Runtime Server while preserving one owner-controlled team definition.
Preserved canonical remote sender addresses and route replies back to the originating Server.
Hardened remote SessionHost handoff, claim expiry, stop ordering, attach routing, and pre-hook Codex readiness detection.
Added structured product changelog and catalog projection contracts for unattended release delivery.

releases.summary: Teaches terminal agents the 0.5.8 remote-team and TeamRelay contracts.

changes.text: Document canonical federated sender addresses, source-Server replies, and exact wildcard recipient scope.
Document Owner Server authority separately from a paired Runtime Server that hosts a placed terminal.
Clarify semantic delivery policy outcomes and safe-boundary handling when no working provider turn is observed.
